bifrost: springboard/src/shell/contactstore.rs (Contact store, search); springboard/apps/contacts-desktop (Contacts app); springboard/src/shell/share/mod.rs (vCard export); springboard/sdk/src/quicksearch.rs (Spotlight index)
summary: Apple deprecated this framework in macOS 10.11 and points to the Contacts framework, which is not in this batch. BifrOSt has a shell-owned contact store with a single-value Contact record, substring search, vCard export and a Contacts app; apps get no SDK API for contacts, and there is no people picker, person view, groups, photos, or change notifications.

features.feature: Address book store and person records
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/contactstore.rs (Contact struct, atomic save to Contacts/contacts.tsv)
features.note: The shell owns the store; no SDK type or call lets an app read or write contacts
One phone, one email and one address per contact; no primary value and no arbitrary number of entries

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/contactstore.rs (search, substring match over name, phone, email, notes, company, address)
features.note: Only a single text query; no property-scoped or compound search elements
No SDK picker or embeddable person view; each app would have to rebuild one
Favorites is a flag on the contact; there are no group records or membership
Export only, for sharing; no vCard import
Contact struct has no image field

Wave 2 (theme-30, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No structured address fields and no locale-aware formatter

features.apple: Overview: apps share contacts with other apps (Mail, Messages)
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/share/mod.rs; springboard/sdk/src/share.rs (NativeSharingServicePicker); springboard/sdk/src/pasteboard.rs; springboard/README.md (Contacts section, copy of phone and email)
features.note: Contacts can be shared as a vCard and values copied; no SDK call for an app to receive a contact

features.apple: Not an Address Book API (search goes through the Contacts framework on macOS)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/quicksearch.rs (apps index their own contacts for the Search panel)
features.note: Indexing is per app; the Contacts app is the only contacts source found
No callback when the contact store changes outside the app

Wave 2 (theme-30, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No contacts permission type; the manifest only has storage
Specific to Apple's Address Book action plug-in model; the Contacts app has no plug-in host

gaps: No SDK API for apps to read, write, or search contacts (the store is shell-internal).
No people picker or person view for apps to embed.
Contacts have one phone, one email and one address; no multi-value properties or primary value.
No groups or group membership; Favorites is a flag only.
No structured postal address fields or formatter.
No change notification when the store changes.
No contacts permission in the app manifest.
Apple deprecated this framework; the modern Contacts framework is the reference and is not covered in this batch.
